body:
@sepo-agent 

To ensure that our README describes all the variables that need setup and where.

Current README only says:
> At least one model-provider credential is configured as a repository secret: OPENAI_API_KEY for Codex-backed runs, or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude-backed runs.

But we didn't say:  it should be in Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions
Add this to readme and/or anywhere relevant?

comments.body: implement requests currently require OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR, CONTRIBUTOR access.

try again? Also i've noticed that after I click "use the template" sepo will start to automatically run Actions for setup and also create an issue that provides check results and additional instructions. Also add this note to readme? @sepo-agent

I triaged this as a `implement` request.

I’ll update the README with clearer setup-secret location guidance and the post-template Actions/check issue behavior.

Reply with:

```text
@sepo-agent /approve req-4170e0
```

to start the implementation workflow.
